processes.realtime_position_variance_notification: Real-time desk reports position, schedule, congestion or charge variances (shorts, cuts, lending, allocations) to schedulers, settlements or support so they can fix or book them in Enpower/CAPS/position manager.
processes.realtime_desk_procedure_instructions: Desk lead sends standing instructions or how-to guidance to the real-time group on procedures such as finals creation, tags, time zones and outages.
processes.misaddressed_email_and_list_correction: Asking senders or list owners to remove the recipient from lists or fix a wrong email address because mail meant for a namesake arrives at the wrong person.
